data.name: Meaning_Quotient
data.value: In a joint return, part of the larger professional income is attributed to the partner who earns less, so it is taxed in their lower bands.

data.name: Hint
data.value: Married or legally cohabiting, you and your partner are taxed jointly: one assessment in both names, each of you taxed on the scale on your own income with your own tax-free amount. The marital quotient attributes part of the larger professional income to the partner who earns less, taxed in their lower bands. Living together without a declaration of legal cohabitation is single for tax.
